key.decision_why: The author answered the alignment question with three new commits and new screenshots, which a triager needs to check, but the PR's approach and scope are unchanged, so a short note under the first card is enough.
key.action_why: laurynmm kept "not ready" and asked the author to clean up the commit history, then said the icon positioning still looked off and sent the author to the #design channel.
changed: Added vertical-align: middle and a small margin-right on .zulip-icon inside .message_length_toggle in web/styles/message_row.css to align the icon with the label text.
Nudged the icon 1px lower with top: 1px.
Updated the after screenshots in the description to show the new alignment in light and dark themes.
still_missing: The commit history contains fixup commits ("Fix formatting via prettier", "Nudge icon alignment by 1px") that need to be squashed into coherent commits per Zulip's commit discipline.
The alignment relies on hand-tuned pixel offsets (vertical-align plus top: 1px), and no maintainer has yet confirmed that the new screenshots look right.
key.reply_ask: Ask the author to squash the alignment, prettier and 1px-nudge fixup commits into clean, coherent commits following the commit-discipline guide, and say a maintainer will then re-check the icon alignment.

must_have.fact: Says the commit history must be cleaned up, because the prettier-formatting and 1px-nudge commits are fixups that should be squashed.
Recommends keeping "not ready" and asking for more work rather than handing the PR off to a reviewer.
Notes that the author answered laurynmm's alignment question by adding vertical-align: middle, margin-right and top: 1px in message_row.css, with updated screenshots.
Flags that the alignment fix is a hand-tuned pixel offset, so the screenshots still need a maintainer or design check (for example in #design on CZO).
Mentions that an earlier PR for the same issue, #38860 by raja-lovescoding, is still open and touches the same two files.
